title: The weak limit C is minimizing in ℝ^P (parent step 1; Simon 7.2.4 (8) and its localization)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ. For j ∈ ℕ let U_j ⊆ ℝ^P be any set and S_j ∈ 𝒟_n(U_j), and let C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) be integer multiplicity (IsIntegerMultiplicity C). Assume (1) for every R ∈ ℝ, closedBall(0, R) ⊆ U_j for all large j; (2) S_j ⇀ C in ℝ^P (ConvergesWeakly: currentEval(S_j, ω) → C(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P)); (3) (local comparison) for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, every ε > 0 and every strictly increasing ψ : ℕ → ℕ there are an open W with K ⊆ W ⊆ thickening(ε, K) = {x : infEdist(x, K) < ε} and a strictly increasing φ′ : ℕ → ℕ such that limsup_{i→∞} M_W(S_{ψ(φ′(i))}) ≤ M_W(S) for every integer multiplicity S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with SameBoundary S C (∂S = ∂C, vacuous for n = 0) and spt(S − C) ⊆ K. Then C is minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn C univ). That is, C is integer multiplicity, and M_W(C) ≤ M_W(S) whenever W ⊆ ℝ^P is open with compact closure, S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) is integer multiplicity, SameBoundary S C holds, and spt(S − C) is compact and contained in W. Here M_O(T) = T.massOn O = sup{max(T(ω), 0) : ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(dom T), tsupport ω ⊆ O, |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x} ∈ [0, ∞] (SimonGMT massOn, Simon 6.2.5, Euclidean coefficient norm), spt is GeometricCurrentOn.support (Simon 6.2.11), and currentEval(S_j, ω) = S_j(ω) if ω is a test form with tsupport ω ⊆ U_j and 0 otherwise.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Us : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (Ss : (j : ℕ) → GeometricCurrentOn (Us j) n) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ R : ℝ, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R ⊆ Us j) → IsIntegerMultiplicity C → ConvergesWeakly Ss C → (∀ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (ε : ℝ), IsCompact K → 0 < ε → ∀ ψ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono ψ → ∃ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W ∧ K ⊆ W ∧ W ⊆ thickening ε K ∧ ∃ φ' : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ' ∧ ∀ S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, IsIntegerMultiplicity S → SameBoundary S C → (S - C).support ⊆ K → limsup (fun j => (Ss (ψ (φ' j))).massOn W) atTop ≤ S.massOn W) → IsMinimizingIn C univ
